description: This file is a Java test class for the DefaultScheduledDateGenerator in the Fineract project. It tests the generation of repayment periods and date adjustments within a loan schedule, specifically focusing on handling different time zones and holiday adjustments.

classes.name: DefaultScheduledDateGeneratorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the DefaultScheduledDateGenerator, including generation of repayment periods and date adjustments considering time zones and holidays.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes MoneyHelper with default rounding mode before each test.

methods.name: test_AdjustRepaymentDate_Works_WithDifferentTenant_And_SystemTimeZone
methods.description: Tests date adjustment logic when tenant and system time zones differ.
